items.title: raw.vives
items.description: An editorial photography archive connecting visual narrative, exploration, series, motion, and accessibility in a statically generated bilingual experience.

items.title: RAW Manager: workspace for photographers
items.description: A full-stack platform that brings clients, sessions, quotes, invoices, galleries, equipment, and production planning into one workspace.
items.role: Designed and implemented the complete product: interface, state, API, authentication, data model, and business workflows.
items.outcome: One focused workspace that replaces scattered tools throughout the complete photography assignment lifecycle.

items.title: Distrito Gourmet: Restaurant web app
items.description: Final course project: a restaurant web platform with a digital menu, dish management, an admin panel, and order and reservation management. The project brings the main restaurant operations into a single application, with a complete flow designed for customers and internal staff.
items.role: Built the React frontend, connected flows with Laravel, and worked on the admin panel, reservations, orders, and visual presentation.
items.outcome: Complete public demo with real restaurant operations: menu, cart, reservations, admin flows, and deployment.

items.title: El Fogón: Restaurant landing page
items.description: Mediterranean restaurant landing built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP. I focused on visual direction, content hierarchy, responsive layout, and simple navigation.
items.role: Defined the visual hierarchy, responsive structure, navigation, and composition for a restaurant landing page.
items.outcome: Lightweight page for presenting menu, visual identity, and reservation intent without unnecessary complexity.

items.title: Hotel Management System (API)
items.description: Hotel reservation API using PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript. I worked on database structure, endpoints, validation, and the core management flow.
items.role: Designed the database structure, main endpoints, validation rules, and reservation management flow.
items.outcome: Functional API for querying, creating, and managing hotel data with a maintainable structure.

items.title: Holiday e-commerce
items.description: Seasonal e-commerce app built with Vue, Vite, and Firebase. It includes category navigation, cart behavior, state management, and a complete shopping flow.
items.role: Implemented category navigation, cart behavior, and state management for a seasonal shopping experience.
items.outcome: Deployed shopping flow that demonstrates interaction, frontend state, and application structure.

items.title: Educational XML project
items.description: Educational site for explaining markup languages and XML structure. I built the interface, content organization, and interactive examples.
items.role: Organized technical content, examples, and navigation to explain XML in a visual and progressive way.
items.outcome: Published educational resource with structured content that is easy for students to follow.

items.role: Worked on visual direction, editorial composition, typography, and production-ready artwork.
items.outcome: Large coherent publication that shows visual judgement also applicable to web interfaces.
